47 void
48 InsnProcessor::process(const BaseSemantics::Dispatcher::Ptr &dispatcher_, SgAsmInstruction *insn_) {
49  DispatcherX86Ptr dispatcher = DispatcherX86::promote(dispatcher_);
50  BaseSemantics::RiscOperators::Ptr operators = dispatcher->operators();
51  SgAsmX86Instruction *insn = isSgAsmX86Instruction(insn_);
52  ASSERT_require(insn!=NULL && insn==operators->currentInstruction());
53  dispatcher->advanceInstructionPointer(insn);
54  SgAsmExpressionPtrList &operands = insn->get_operandList()->get_operands();
55  check_arg_width(dispatcher.get(), insn, operands);
56 
57  operators->comment("executing instruction core");
58  p(dispatcher.get(), operators.get(), insn, operands);
59 }

61 void
62 InsnProcessor::assert_args(I insn, A args, size_t nargs) {
63  if (args.size()!=nargs) {
64  std::string mesg = "instruction must have " + StringUtility::plural(nargs, "arguments");
65  throw BaseSemantics::Exception(mesg, insn);
66  }
67 }

69 // This is here because we don't fully support 64-bit mode yet, and a few of the support functions will fail in bad ways.
70 // E.g., "jmp ds:[rip+0x200592]" will try to read32() the argument and then fail an assertion because it isn't 32 bits wide.
71 // Note that even 32-bit x86 architectures might have registers that are larger than 32 bits (e.g., xmm registers on a
72 // Pentium4). Therefore, we consult the register dictionary and only fail if the operand is larger than 32 bits and
73 // contains a register which isn't part of the dictionary.
74 void
75 InsnProcessor::check_arg_width(D d, I insn, A args) {
76  for (size_t i=0; i<args.size(); ++i) {
77  const size_t nBits = asm_type_width(args[i]->get_type());
78  if (nBits > 32) {
79  AST::Traversal::forwardPre<SgAsmRegisterReferenceExpression>(args[i],
80  [&d, &insn, &nBits](SgAsmRegisterReferenceExpression *rre) {
81  RegisterDictionary::Ptr regdict = d->registerDictionary();
82  ASSERT_not_null(regdict);
83  if (regdict->lookup(rre->get_descriptor()).empty())
84  throw BaseSemantics::Exception(StringUtility::numberToString(nBits) +
85  "-bit operands not supported for " + regdict->name(),
86  insn);
87  });
88  }
89  }
90 }

102 // ASCII adjust after addition
103 struct IP_aaa: P {
104  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
105  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
106  if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_16) {
107  throw BaseSemantics::NotImplemented("16-bit processor not implemented", insn);
108  } else if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_32) {
109  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
110  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
111  } else {
112  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr nybble = ops->extract(d->readRegister(d->REG_AL), 0, 4);
113  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr incAh = ops->or_(d->readRegister(d->REG_AF), d->greaterOrEqualToTen(nybble));
114  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX,
115  ops->concat(ops->add(ops->ite(incAh, ops->number_(4, 6), ops->number_(4, 0)),
116  ops->extract(d->readRegister(d->REG_AL), 0, 4)),
117  ops->concat(ops->number_(4, 0),
118  ops->add(ops->ite(incAh, ops->number_(8, 1), ops->number_(8, 0)),
119  d->readRegister(d->REG_AH)))));
120  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
121  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
122  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
123  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
124  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, incAh);
125  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, incAh);
126  }
127  } else {
128  ASSERT_require(d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_64);
129  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
130  }
131  }
132 };
133 
134 // ASCII adjust AX before division
135 struct IP_aad: P {
136  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
137  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
138  if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_16) {
139  throw BaseSemantics::NotImplemented("16-bit processor not implemented", insn);
140  } else if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_32) {
141  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
142  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
143  } else {
144  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr al = d->readRegister(d->REG_AL);
145  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ah = d->readRegister(d->REG_AH);
146  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr divisor = d->read(args[0], 8);
147  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newAl = ops->add(al, ops->extract(ops->unsignedMultiply(ah, divisor), 0, 8));
148  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX, ops->concat(newAl, ops->number_(8, 0)));
149  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
150  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
151  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, ops->unspecified_(1));
152  d->setFlagsForResult(newAl);
153  }
154  } else {
155  ASSERT_require(d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_64);
156  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
157  }
158  }
159 };
160 
161 // ASCII adjust AX after multiply
162 // AAM -- implied immediate value is 0x0a and stored explicitly as an argument
163 // AAM ib -- immediate values other than 0x0a
164 struct IP_aam: P {
165  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
166  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
167  if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_16) {
168  throw BaseSemantics::NotImplemented("16-bit processor not implemented", insn);
169  } else if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_32) {
170  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr divisor = d->read(args[0], 8);
171  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
172  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
173  } else if (divisor->toUnsigned().isEqual(0)) {
174  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_de, 0);
175  } else {
176  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr al = d->readRegister(d->REG_AL);
177  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newAh = ops->unsignedDivide(al, divisor);
178  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newAl = ops->unsignedModulo(al, divisor);
179  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX, ops->concat(newAl, newAh));
180  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
181  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
182  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, ops->unspecified_(1));
183  d->setFlagsForResult(newAl);
184  }
185  } else {
186  ASSERT_require(d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_64);
187  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
188  }
189  }
190 };
191 
192 // ASCII adjust AL after subtraction
193 struct IP_aas: P {
194  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
195  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
196  if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_16) {
197  throw BaseSemantics::NotImplemented("16-bit processor not implemented", insn);
198  } else if (d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_32) {
199  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
200  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
201  } else {
202  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr nybble = ops->extract(d->readRegister(d->REG_AL), 0, 4);
203  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr nybbleGte10 = d->greaterOrEqualToTen(nybble);
204  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr decAh = ops->or_(d->readRegister(d->REG_AF), nybbleGte10);
205  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ah = d->readRegister(d->REG_AH);
206  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero8 = ops->number_(8, 0);
207  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newAh = ops->add(ops->ite(decAh, ops->number_(8, -1), zero8), ah);
208  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newAhWide = ops->concat(ops->number_(4, 0), newAh);
209  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr alNarrow = ops->extract(d->readRegister(d->REG_AL), 0, 4);
210  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero4 = ops->number_(4, 0);
211 
212  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX,
213  ops->concat(ops->add(ops->ite(decAh, ops->number_(4, -6), zero4), alNarrow),
214  newAhWide));
215  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
216  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
217  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
218  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
219  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, decAh);
220  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, decAh);
221  }
222  } else {
223  ASSERT_require(d->processorMode() == x86_insnsize_64);
224  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
225  }
226  }
227 };

229 // Add with carry
230 struct IP_adc: P {
231  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
232  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
233  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
234  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
235  } else {
236  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr cf = d->readRegister(d->REG_CF);
237  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr arg1 = d->read(args[1]);
238  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = d->doAddOperation(d->read(args[0]), arg1, false, cf);
239  d->write(args[0], result);
240  }
241  }

244 // Add two values
245 struct IP_add: P {
246  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
247  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
248  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
249  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
250  } else {
251  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr no = ops->boolean_(false);
252  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr arg1 = d->read(args[1]);
253  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = d->doAddOperation(d->read(args[0]), arg1, false, no);
254  d->write(args[0], result);

256  }

259 // Bitwise AND
260 struct IP_and: P {
261  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
262  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
263  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
264  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
265  } else {
266  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
267  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
268  if (b->nBits() < a->nBits())
269  b = ops->signExtend(b, a->nBits());
270  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = ops->and_(a, b);
271  d->setFlagsForResult(result);
272  d->write(args[0], result);
273  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->boolean_(false));
274  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
275  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, ops->boolean_(false));
276  }
277  }
278 };

280 // Bit scan forward or reverse
281 struct IP_bitscan: P {
282  const X86InstructionKind kind;
283  IP_bitscan(X86InstructionKind k): kind(k) {
284  ASSERT_require(x86_bsf==k || x86_bsr==k);
285  }
286  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
287  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
288  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
289  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
290  } else {
291  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
292  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
293  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
294  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
295  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, ops->unspecified_(1));
296  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
297  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1], nbits);
298  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isZero = ops->equalToZero(src);
299  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, isZero);
300  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bitno;
301  ASSERT_require(insn->get_kind()==kind);
302  switch (kind) {
303  case x86_bsf: bitno = ops->leastSignificantSetBit(src); break;
304  case x86_bsr: bitno = ops->mostSignificantSetBit(src); break;
305  default: ASSERT_not_reachable("instruction kind not handled");
306  }
307  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = ops->ite(isZero, ops->unspecified_(nbits), bitno);
308  d->write(args[0], result);
309  }
310  }
311 };
312 
313 // Bit test instructions: BT, BTR
314 struct IP_bittest: P {
315  const X86InstructionKind kind;
316  IP_bittest(X86InstructionKind k): kind(k) {
317  ASSERT_require(x86_bt==k || x86_btr==k || x86_bts==k || x86_btc==k);
318  }
319  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
320  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
321  ASSERT_require(insn->get_kind()==kind);
322  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && (x86_bt==kind || !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0]))) {
323  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
324  } else if (SgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression *mre = isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
325  const size_t addrSize = d->REG_anyIP.nBits();
326  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bitBase = ops->unsignedExtend(d->effectiveAddress(mre), addrSize);
327  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bitOffset = ops->signExtend(d->read(args[1]), addrSize);
328 
329  // Byte offset from bitBase address is signed. If negative, the bit is at the previous memory address. E.g.:
330  // if bitBase==100 && bitOffset==+13 then cf = mem[101] & (1<<5);
331  // if bitBase==100 && bitOffset==-13 then cf = mem[99] & (1<<5)
332  // Notice that the bit offset within a byte is always positive (i.e., |bitOffset|%8) and that in the second
333  // example (for bitOffset==-13) the bit offset within the memory byte is 5, not 3. This information comes from
334  // the Intel Instruction Set Reference and has not been tested by us. [Robb P. Matzke 2015-02-24]
335  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr byteOffset = ops->shiftRightArithmetic(bitOffset, ops->number_(8, 3));
336  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr addr = d->fixMemoryAddress(ops->add(bitBase, byteOffset));
337  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
338  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefA = ops->undefined_(8);
339  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr fixedAddr = d->fixMemoryAddress(addr);
340  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr byte = ops->readMemory(d->segmentRegister(mre), fixedAddr, undefA, yes);
341  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr offsetA = ops->extract(bitOffset, 0, 3); // for positive bitOffset
342  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr offsetB = ops->extract(ops->negate(bitOffset), 0, 3); // for negative bitOffset
343 
344  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr shiftAmount =
345  ops->ite(ops->extract(bitOffset, bitOffset->nBits()-1, bitOffset->nBits()),
346  offsetB, offsetA);
347  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bit = ops->extract(ops->shiftRight(byte, shiftAmount), 0, 1);
348  switch (kind) {
349  case x86_bt: // test only
350  break;
351  case x86_btr: // clear bit
352  byte = ops->and_(byte, ops->invert(ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(8, 1), shiftAmount)));
353  ops->writeMemory(d->segmentRegister(mre), addr, byte, yes);
354  break;
355  case x86_bts: // set bit
356  byte = ops->or_(byte, ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(8, 1), shiftAmount));
357  ops->writeMemory(d->segmentRegister(mre), addr, byte, yes);
358  break;
359  case x86_btc: // complement bit
360  byte = ops->xor_(byte, ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(8, 1), shiftAmount));
361  ops->writeMemory(d->segmentRegister(mre), addr, byte, yes);
362  break;
363  default:
364  ASSERT_not_reachable("instruction kind not handled");
365  }
366  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, bit);
367  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
368  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
369  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
370  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
371  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
372  } else {
373  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bits = d->read(args[0]);
374  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bitOffset = d->read(args[1]);
375  size_t log2modulo;
376  switch (bits->nBits()) {
377  case 16: log2modulo = 4; break;
378  case 32: log2modulo = 5; break;
379  case 64: log2modulo = 6; break;
380  default: ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid width for first operand");
381  }
382  ASSERT_require(bitOffset->nBits() >= log2modulo);
383  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr shiftAmount = ops->extract(bitOffset, 0, log2modulo);
384  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bit = ops->extract(ops->shiftRight(bits, shiftAmount), 0, 1);
385  switch (kind) {
386  case x86_bt: // test only
387  break;
388  case x86_btr: // clear bit
389  bits = ops->and_(bits, ops->invert(ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(bits->nBits(), 1), shiftAmount)));
390  d->write(args[0], bits);
391  break;
392  case x86_bts: // set bit
393  bits = ops->or_(bits, ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(bits->nBits(), 1), shiftAmount));
394  d->write(args[0], bits);
395  break;
396  case x86_btc: // complement bit
397  bits = ops->xor_(bits, ops->shiftLeft(ops->number_(bits->nBits(), 1), shiftAmount));
398  d->write(args[0], bits);
399  break;
400  default:
401  ASSERT_not_reachable("instruction kind not handled");
402  }
403  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, bit);
404  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
405  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
406  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
407  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
408  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
409  }
410  }
411 };
412 
413 // Byte swap (reverse byte order)
414 struct IP_bswap: P {
415  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
416  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
417  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
418  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
419  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
420  } else if (16 == nbits) {
421  // Intel ref manual says "When the BSWAP instruction references a 16-bit register, the result is
422  // undefined".
423  d->write(args[0], ops->unspecified_(16));
424  } else {
425  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr op0 = d->read(args[0], nbits);
426  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = ops->extract(op0, 0, 8);
427  for (size_t startbit=8; startbit<nbits; startbit+=8)
428  result = ops->concat(ops->extract(op0, startbit, startbit+8), result);
429  d->write(args[0], result);
430  }
431  }
432 };
433 
434 // Call procedure
435 struct IP_call: P {
436  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
437  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
438  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
439  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
440  } else {
441  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr targetVa = ops->unsignedExtend(d->read(args[0]), d->REG_anyIP.nBits());
442 
443  // Push return address onto stack
444  size_t nBytesPush = d->REG_anyIP.nBits() >> 3;
445  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldSp = d->readRegister(d->REG_anySP);
446  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newSp = ops->add(oldSp, ops->number_(d->REG_anySP.nBits(), -nBytesPush));
447  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
448  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ip = d->readRegister(d->REG_anyIP);
449  ops->writeMemory(d->REG_SS, d->fixMemoryAddress(newSp), ip, yes);
450  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, newSp);;
451 
452  // Branch
453  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anyIP, ops->filterCallTarget(targetVa));
454  }
455  }
456 };

506 // Clear direction flag
507 struct IP_cld: P {

509  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
510  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
511  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
512  } else {
513  d->writeRegister(d->REG_DF, ops->boolean_(false));
514  }
515  }
516 };

518 // Flush cache line

523  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
524  } else {
525  // read memory for its side effects (e.g., page faults), but don't do anything else since semantics has no cache
526  // lines.
527  (void) d->read(args[0]);
528  }
529  }

549  x86_cmovns==k || x86_cmovs==k || x86_cmovae==k || x86_cmovb==k || x86_cmovbe==k || x86_cmova==k ||
550  x86_cmovle==k || x86_cmovg==k || x86_cmovge==k || x86_cmovl==k);

561  }

565 // Compare two values
566 struct IP_cmp: P {
567  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
568  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
569  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
570  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
571  } else {
572  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
573  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
574  if (b->nBits() < a->nBits())
575  b = ops->signExtend(b, a->nBits());
576  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
577 
578  // Compute a-b for its status register side effects
579  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr no = ops->boolean_(false);
580  (void) d->doAddOperation(a, ops->invert(b), true, no);
581  }
582  }
583 };
584 
585 // Compare strings
586 // CMPSD is also a floating-point instruction when it has two operands
587 // The disassembler produces CMPSB, CMPSW, CMPSD, or CMPSQ without any arguments (never CMPS with an arg).
588 struct IP_cmpstrings: P {
589  const X86RepeatPrefix repeat;
590  const size_t nbits;
591  const size_t nbytes;
592  IP_cmpstrings(X86RepeatPrefix repeat, size_t nbits): repeat(repeat), nbits(nbits), nbytes(nbits/8) {
593  ASSERT_require(8==nbits || 16==nbits || 32==nbits || 64==nbits);
594  }
595  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
596  if (insn->get_kind()==x86_cmpsd && args.size() == 2) {
597  // This is a floating point instruction: compare scalar double-precision floating-point values
598  throw BaseSemantics::NotImplemented("no dispatch ability for \"" + insn->get_mnemonic() + "\" instruction", insn);
599  }
600 
601  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
602  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
603  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
604  } else {
605  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr inLoop = d->repEnter(repeat);
606 
607  // Get the addresses for the two values to read and compare.
608  RegisterDescriptor reg1, reg2;
609  switch (insn->get_addressSize()) {
610  case x86_insnsize_16:
611  reg1 = d->REG_SI;
612  reg2 = d->REG_DI;
613  break;
614  case x86_insnsize_32:
615  reg1 = d->REG_ESI;
616  reg2 = d->REG_EDI;
617  break;
618  case x86_insnsize_64:
619  reg1 = d->REG_RSI;
620  reg2 = d->REG_RDI;
621  break;
622  default:
623  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid instruction address size");
624  }
625  ASSERT_forbid(reg1.isEmpty());
626  ASSERT_forbid(reg2.isEmpty());
627  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr addr1 = d->readRegister(reg1);
628  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr addr2 = d->readRegister(reg2);
629 
630  // Adjust address width depending on how memory is accessed. All addresses in memory have the same width.
631  addr1 = d->fixMemoryAddress(addr1);
632  addr2 = d->fixMemoryAddress(addr2);
633  ASSERT_require(addr1->nBits() == addr2->nBits());
634 
635  // Read the two values from memory.
636  RegisterDescriptor sr(x86_regclass_segment,
637  insn->get_segmentOverride()!=x86_segreg_none ? insn->get_segmentOverride() : x86_segreg_ds,
638  0, 16);
639  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr val1 = ops->readMemory(sr, addr1, ops->undefined_(nbits), inLoop);
640  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr val2 = ops->readMemory(d->REG_ES, addr2, ops->undefined_(nbits), inLoop);
641 
642  // Compare values and set status flags.
643  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr no = ops->boolean_(false);
644  (void) d->doAddOperation(val1, ops->invert(val2), true, no, inLoop);
645 
646  // Adjust the address registers
647  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr positiveNBytes = ops->number_(reg1.nBits(), +nbytes);
648  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr negativeNBytes = ops->number_(reg1.nBits(), -nbytes);
649  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr step = ops->ite(d->readRegister(d->REG_DF), negativeNBytes, positiveNBytes);
650  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr reg1val = d->readRegister(reg1);
651  d->writeRegister(reg1, ops->ite(inLoop, ops->add(d->readRegister(reg1), step), reg1val));
652  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr reg2val = d->readRegister(reg2);
653  d->writeRegister(reg2, ops->ite(inLoop, ops->add(d->readRegister(reg2), step), reg2val));
654 
655  // Adjust instruction pointer register to either repeat the instruction or fall through
656  if (x86_repeat_none!=repeat)
657  d->repLeave(repeat, inLoop, insn->get_address(), true/*use ZF*/);
658  }
659  }
660 };
661 
662 // Compare and exchange
663 struct IP_cmpxchg: P {
664  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
665  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
666  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
667  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
668  } else {
669  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
670  ASSERT_require(asm_type_width(args[1]->get_type()) == nbits);
671  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr op0 = d->read(args[0]);
672  RegisterDescriptor A = d->REG_AX;
673  A.nBits(nbits);
674  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldA = d->readRegister(A);
675  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr no = ops->boolean_(false);
676  (void) d->doAddOperation(oldA, ops->invert(op0), true, no);
677  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zf = d->readRegister(d->REG_ZF);
678  d->write(args[0], ops->ite(zf, d->read(args[1]), op0));
679  d->writeRegister(A, ops->ite(zf, oldA, op0));
680  }
681  }
682 };
683 
684 // Compare and exchange bytes
685 // CMPXCHG8B
686 // CMPXCHG16B
687 struct IP_cmpxchg2: P {
688  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
689  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
690  if (!isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
691  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
692  } else {
693  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
694  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b, c;
695  switch (a->nBits()) {
696  case 64: {
697  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr edx = d->readRegister(d->REG_EDX);
698  b = ops->concat(d->readRegister(d->REG_EAX), edx);
699  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ecx = d->readRegister(d->REG_ECX);
700  c = ops->concat(d->readRegister(d->REG_EBX), ecx);
701  break;
702  }
703  case 128: {
704  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr rdx = d->readRegister(d->REG_RDX);
705  b = ops->concat(d->readRegister(d->REG_RAX), rdx);
706  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr rcx = d->readRegister(d->REG_RCX);
707  c = ops->concat(d->readRegister(d->REG_RBX), rcx);
708  break;
709  }
710  default:
711  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid operand width for CMPXCHG8B instruction");
712  }
713  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr eq = ops->isEqual(a, b);
714  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, eq);
715  d->write(args[0], ops->ite(eq, c, a));
716  }
717  }
718 };

756 // Convert dword integer to scalar double-precision FP value

810 // division instructions: IDIV, DIV
811 struct IP_divide: P {
812  const X86InstructionKind kind;
813  IP_divide(X86InstructionKind k): kind(k) {
814  ASSERT_require(x86_div==k || x86_idiv==k);
815  }
816  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
817  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
818  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
819  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
820  } else {
821  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
822  RegisterDescriptor regA = d->REG_AX; regA.nBits(8==nbits ? 16 : nbits);
823  RegisterDescriptor regD = d->REG_DX; regD.nBits(8==nbits ? 16 : nbits);
824  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dividend;
825  if (8==nbits) {
826  dividend = d->readRegister(regA);
827  } else {
828  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr regDVal = d->readRegister(regD);
829  dividend = ops->concat(d->readRegister(regA), regDVal);
830  }
831  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr divisor = d->read(args[0]);
832  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr divResult, modResult;
833  ASSERT_require(insn->get_kind()==kind);
834  switch (kind) {
835  case x86_idiv:
836  divResult = ops->signedDivide(dividend, divisor);
837  modResult = ops->signedModulo(dividend, divisor);
838  break;
839  case x86_div:
840  divResult = ops->unsignedDivide(dividend, divisor);
841  modResult = ops->unsignedModulo(dividend, divisor);
842  break;
843  default:
844  ASSERT_not_reachable("instruction kind not handled");
845  }
846  if (8==nbits) {
847  d->writeRegister(regA, ops->concat(ops->extract(divResult, 0, 8), modResult));
848  } else {
849  d->writeRegister(regA, ops->extract(divResult, 0, nbits));
850  d->writeRegister(regD, modResult);
851  }
852  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
853  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
854  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
855  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
856  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, ops->unspecified_(1));
857  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, ops->unspecified_(1));
858  }
859  }
860 };

954 // Signed multiply.
955 // Note that the Intel documentation's assertion that "the two- and three-operand forms may also be used with unsigned operands
956 // because the lower half of the product is the same regardless if the operands are signed or unsigned" is nonsense when the
957 // factors are not the same width and the second factor is thus sign extended before the product is computed. E.g., "IMUL r64,
958 // imm32" when applied to 1 x 4294967295 results in "-1" (0xffffffffffffffff) not 4294967295 (0x00000000ffffffff).
959 struct IP_imul: P {
960  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
961  ASSERT_require(args.size() >= 1);
962  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
963  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
964  } else {
965  // Read the two factors to be multiplied.
966  size_t arg0Width = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
967  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr factor1, factor2;
968  if (1 == args.size()) {
969  if (8 == arg0Width) {
970  factor1 = d->readRegister(d->REG_AL);
971  factor2 = d->read(args[0]);
972  } else {
973  RegisterDescriptor reg0 = d->REG_AX; reg0.nBits(arg0Width);
974  factor1 = d->readRegister(reg0);
975  factor2 = d->read(args[0]);
976  }
977  } else if (2 == args.size()) {
978  ASSERT_require(arg0Width > 8);
979  ASSERT_require(asm_type_width(args[1]->get_type()) <= arg0Width);
980  factor1 = d->read(args[0]);
981  factor2 = ops->signExtend(d->read(args[1]), arg0Width);
982  } else if (3 == args.size()) {
983  ASSERT_require(arg0Width > 8);
984  ASSERT_require(asm_type_width(args[1]->get_type()) == arg0Width);
985  ASSERT_require(asm_type_width(args[2]->get_type()) <= arg0Width);
986  factor1 = d->read(args[1]);
987  factor2 = ops->signExtend(d->read(args[2]), arg0Width);
988  }
989 
990  // Obtain the result
991  ASSERT_not_null(factor1);
992  ASSERT_not_null(factor2);
993  ASSERT_require(factor1->nBits() == factor2->nBits());
994  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr product = ops->signedMultiply(factor1, factor2);
995 
996  // Store the result
997  if (1 == args.size()) {
998  if (8 == arg0Width) {
999  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX, product);
1000  } else {
1001  RegisterDescriptor aReg = d->REG_AX; aReg.nBits(arg0Width);
1002  RegisterDescriptor dReg = d->REG_DX; dReg.nBits(arg0Width);
1003  d->writeRegister(aReg, ops->extract(product, 0, arg0Width));
1004  d->writeRegister(dReg, ops->extract(product, arg0Width, 2*arg0Width));
1005  }
1006  } else {
1007  d->write(args[0], ops->extract(product, 0, arg0Width));
1008  }
1009 
1010  // Carry flag set when high-order bits of the product are not all equal to the low-half's sign bit. In other words,
1011  // when the high-half bits are not all clear or not all set or when the high-half sign bit is not equal to the
1012  // low-half sign bit.
1013  ASSERT_require(product->nBits() % 2 == 0);
1014  size_t productHalfWidth = product->nBits() / 2;
1015  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr lh_signbit = ops->extract(product, productHalfWidth-1, productHalfWidth);
1016  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr hh_signbit = ops->extract(product, product->nBits()-1, product->nBits());
1017  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr hh = ops->extract(product, productHalfWidth, product->nBits());
1018  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr z1 = ops->equalToZero(ops->invert(hh));
1019  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr hh_allsame = ops->or_(ops->equalToZero(hh), z1);
1020  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr signsame = ops->equalToZero(ops->xor_(lh_signbit, hh_signbit));
1021  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr carry = ops->invert(ops->and_(hh_allsame, signsame));
1022 
1023  // Update status flags
1024  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, carry);
1025  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, carry);
1026  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1027  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1028  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1029  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1030  }
1031  }
1032 };
1033 
1034 // Increment
1035 struct IP_inc: P {
1036  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1037  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
1038  if (insn->get_lockPrefix() && !isSgAsmMemoryReferenceExpression(args[0])) {
1039  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1040  } else {
1041  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = d->doIncOperation(d->read(args[0]), false, false);
1042  d->write(args[0], result);
1043  }
1044  }
1045 };

1047 // Call to interrupt procedure
1048 struct IP_int: P {
1049  void p(D, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {

1051  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1052  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1053  } else {
1054  SgAsmIntegerValueExpression *bv = isSgAsmIntegerValueExpression(args[0]);
1055  if (!bv)
1056  throw BaseSemantics::Exception("operand must be a byte value expression", insn);
1057  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_int, bv->get_value());
1058  }
1059  }

1062 // Call to the interrupt 3 procedure (for debugging), but slightly different semantics than the one-argument "INT 3"
1063 // instruction.
1064 struct IP_int3: P {

1066  assert_args(insn, args, 0);

1068  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1069  } else {
1070  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_int, -3);

1072  }

1075 // Jump
1076 // The argument must be an absolute address, not an offset. The disassembler takes care of that for us.
1077 struct IP_jmp: P {
1078  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1079  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
1080  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1081  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1082  } else {
1083  size_t tgtWidth = d->REG_anyIP.nBits();
1084  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr tgt = ops->filterIndirectJumpTarget(ops->unsignedExtend(d->read(args[0]), tgtWidth));
1085  if (insn->get_operandSize() == x86_insnsize_16 && tgtWidth == 32) {
1086  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero16 = ops->number_(16, 0);
1087  tgt = ops->concat(ops->extract(tgt, 0, 16), zero16);
1088  }
1089  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anyIP, tgt);
1090  }
1091  }
1092 };

1094 // Jump if condition is met
1095 struct IP_jcc: P {
1096  const X86InstructionKind kind;
1097  IP_jcc(X86InstructionKind k): kind(k) {
1098  ASSERT_require(x86_jne==k || x86_je==k || x86_jno==k || x86_jo==k || x86_jns==k || x86_js==k ||
1099  x86_jpo==k || x86_jpe==k || x86_jae==k || x86_jb==k || x86_jbe==k || x86_ja==k ||
1100  x86_jl==k || x86_jge==k || x86_jle==k || x86_jg==k || x86_jcxz==k || x86_jecxz==k);
1101  }
1102  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1103  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
1104  ASSERT_require(insn->get_kind()==kind);
1105  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1106  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1107  } else {
1108  size_t tgtWidth = d->REG_anyIP.nBits();
1109  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr cond = d->flagsCombo(kind);
1110  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ip = d->readRegister(d->REG_anyIP);
1111  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr tgt = ops->ite(cond,
1112  ops->unsignedExtend(d->read(args[0]), tgtWidth),
1113  ip);
1114  if (insn->get_operandSize() == x86_insnsize_16 && tgtWidth == 32) {
1115  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero16 = ops->number_(16, 0);
1116  tgt = ops->concat(ops->extract(tgt, 0, 16), zero16);
1117  }
1118  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anyIP, tgt);
1119  }
1120  }
1121 };
1122 
1123 // Load MXCSR register
1124 struct IP_ldmxcsr: P {

1128  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1129  } else {
1130  d->writeRegister(d->REG_MXCSR, d->read(args[0]));
1131  }
1132  }

1135 // Load effective address
1136 struct IP_lea: P {

1141  } else {
1142  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());

1148 // High-level procedure exit
1149 struct IP_leave: P {
1150  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1151  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
1152  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1153  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1154  } else {
1155  size_t nbitsBP = d->REG_anyBP.nBits();
1156  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, d->readRegister(d->REG_anyBP));
1157  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldSP = d->readRegister(d->REG_anySP);
1158  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newSP = ops->add(oldSP, ops->number_(oldSP->nBits(), nbitsBP/8));
1159  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr addr = d->fixMemoryAddress(oldSP);
1160  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
1161  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anyBP, ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, addr, ops->undefined_(nbitsBP), yes));
1162  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, newSP);
1163  }
1164  }
1165 };

1167 // Read time-stamp counter
1168 struct IP_rdtsc: P {
1169  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1170  assert_args(insn, args, 0);

1172  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1173  } else {
1174  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr tsc = ops->rdtsc();
1175  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EAX, ops->extract(tsc, 0, 32));
1176  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EDX, ops->extract(tsc, 32, 64));
1177  }
1178  }

1181 // Load string
1182 // The disassembler produces LODSB, LODSW, LODSD, or LODSQ without any arguments (never LODS with an arg).
1183 struct IP_loadstring: P {
1184  const X86RepeatPrefix repeat;
1185  const size_t nbits;
1186  const size_t nbytes;
1187  IP_loadstring(X86RepeatPrefix repeat, size_t nbits): repeat(repeat), nbits(nbits), nbytes(nbits/8) {
1188  ASSERT_require(8==nbits || 16==nbits || 32==nbits || 64==nbits);
1189  }
1190  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1191  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
1192  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1193  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1194  } else {
1195  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr inLoop = d->repEnter(repeat);
1196 
1197  // Get the address for the string to load.
1198  RegisterDescriptor srcReg;
1199  switch (insn->get_addressSize()) {
1200  case x86_insnsize_16:
1201  srcReg = d->REG_SI;
1202  break;
1203  case x86_insnsize_32:
1204  srcReg = d->REG_ESI;
1205  break;
1206  case x86_insnsize_64:
1207  srcReg = d->REG_RSI;
1208  break;
1209  default:
1210  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid instruction address size");
1211  }
1212  ASSERT_forbid(srcReg.isEmpty());
1213  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr stringPtr = d->readRegister(srcReg);
1214 
1215  // Adjust address width based on how memory is accessed. All addresses in memory have the same width.
1216  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr addr = d->fixMemoryAddress(stringPtr);
1217 
1218  // Load the byte, word, dword, or qword from memory.
1219  RegisterDescriptor sr(x86_regclass_segment,
1220  insn->get_segmentOverride()!=x86_segreg_none ? insn->get_segmentOverride() : x86_segreg_ds,
1221  0, 16);
1222  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr val = ops->readMemory(sr, addr, ops->undefined_(nbits), inLoop);
1223 
1224  // Save value into destination register
1225  RegisterDescriptor dstReg = d->REG_AX; dstReg.nBits(nbits);
1226  d->writeRegister(dstReg, val);
1227 
1228  // Advance pointer register
1229  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr positiveNBytes = ops->number_(srcReg.nBits(), +nbytes);
1230  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr negativeNBytes = ops->number_(srcReg.nBits(), -nbytes);
1231  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr step = ops->ite(d->readRegister(d->REG_DF), negativeNBytes, positiveNBytes);
1232  d->writeRegister(srcReg, ops->ite(inLoop, ops->add(stringPtr, step), stringPtr));
1233 
1234  // Adjust the instruction pointer register to either repeat the instruction or fall through
1235  if (x86_repeat_none != repeat)
1236  d->repLeave(repeat, inLoop, insn->get_address(), false/*no ZF*/);
1237  }
1238  }
1239 };
1240 
1241 // Loop according to ECX counter: LOOP, LOOPNZ, LOOPZ
1242 struct IP_loop: P {
1243  const X86InstructionKind kind;
1244  IP_loop(X86InstructionKind k): kind(k) {
1245  ASSERT_require(x86_loop==k || x86_loopnz==k || x86_loopz==k);
1246  }
1247  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1248  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
1249  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1250  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1251  } else {
1252  // Which register is used for counting?
1253  RegisterDescriptor counterReg;
1254  switch (insn->get_addressSize()) {
1255  case x86_insnsize_16:
1256  counterReg = d->REG_DX;
1257  break;
1258  case x86_insnsize_32:
1259  counterReg = d->REG_EDX;
1260  break;
1261  case x86_insnsize_64:
1262  counterReg = d->REG_RDX;
1263  break;
1264  default:
1265  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid instruction address size");
1266  }
1267 
1268  // Decrement the counter
1269  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldCounter = d->readRegister(counterReg);
1270  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newCounter = ops->add(oldCounter, ops->number_(oldCounter->nBits(), -1));
1271  d->writeRegister(counterReg, newCounter);
1272 
1273  // Should we loop?
1274  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr doLoop;
1275  ASSERT_require(insn->get_kind() == kind);
1276  switch (kind) {
1277  case x86_loop:
1278  doLoop = ops->invert(ops->equalToZero(newCounter));
1279  break;
1280  case x86_loopnz: {
1281  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr notZf = ops->invert(d->readRegister(d->REG_ZF));
1282  doLoop = ops->and_(ops->invert(ops->equalToZero(newCounter)), notZf);
1283  break;
1284  }
1285  case x86_loopz: {
1286  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zf = d->readRegister(d->REG_ZF);
1287  doLoop = ops->and_(ops->invert(ops->equalToZero(newCounter)), zf);
1288  break;
1289  }
1290  default:
1291  ASSERT_not_reachable("instruction type not handled");
1292  }
1293 
1294  // Adjust the instruction pointer to either loop or fall through.
1295  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ip = d->readRegister(d->REG_anyIP);
1296  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anyIP, ops->ite(doLoop, d->read(args[0], d->REG_anyIP.nBits()), ip));
1297  }
1298  }
1299 };
1300 
1301 // Store selected bytes
1302 // MASKMOVQ
1303 struct IP_maskmov: P {
1304  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1305  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1306  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1307  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1308  } else {
1309  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[0]);
1310  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr mask = d->read(args[1]);
1311  ASSERT_require(src->nBits() == mask->nBits());
1312  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr startVa = d->readRegister(d->REG_EDI);
1313  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
1314  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr mem = ops->readMemory(d->REG_DS, startVa, ops->undefined_(src->nBits()), yes);
1315  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
1316  size_t nOps = src->nBits() / 8;
1317  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
1318  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partMask = ops->extract(mask, i*8, i*8+1);
1319  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr v2 = ops->extract(mem, i*8, i*8+8);
1320  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr byte = ops->ite(partMask, ops->extract(src, i*8, i*8+8), v2);
1321  result = result ? ops->concat(result, byte) : byte;
1322  }
1323  ops->writeMemory(d->REG_DS, startVa, result, ops->boolean_(true));
1324  }
1325  }
1326 };
1327 
1328 // The MOV instruction
1329 struct IP_mov: P {
1330  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1331  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1332  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1333  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1334  } else {
1335  size_t dstWidth = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
1336  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr value = d->read(args[1]);
1337  if (dstWidth > value->nBits()) {
1338  // MOV r/m64, imm32 uses sign extend, but all others use unsigned extend or truncation.
1339  if (64==dstWidth && isSgAsmIntegerValueExpression(args[1])) {
1340  value = ops->signExtend(value, 64);
1341  } else {
1342  value = ops->unsignedExtend(value, dstWidth);
1343  }
1344  }
1345  d->write(args[0], value);
1346  }
1347  }
1348 };
1349 
1350 // Move data after swapping bytes
1351 struct IP_movbe: P {
1352  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1353  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1354  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1355  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1356  } else {
1357  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
1358  size_t nBytes = src->nBits() / 8;
1359  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
1360  for (size_t i=0; i<nBytes; ++i) {
1361  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr byte = ops->extract(src, i*8, (i+1)*8);
1362  result = result ? ops->concat(byte, result) : byte;
1363  }
1364  d->write(args[0], result);
1365  }
1366  }
1367 };

1369 // Move high packed double-precision floating-point value
1370 struct IP_movhpd: P {
1371  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1372  assert_args(insn, args, 2);

1374  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1375  } else if (SgAsmDirectRegisterExpression *rre = isSgAsmDirectRegisterExpression(args[0])) {
1376  RegisterDescriptor reg = rre->get_descriptor();

1378  reg.offset(64);
1379  reg.nBits(64);
1380  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr val = d->read(args[1]);
1381  ASSERT_require(val->nBits() == 64);
1382  d->writeRegister(reg, val);

1384  RegisterDescriptor reg = rre->get_descriptor();
1385  ASSERT_require(reg.offset() == 0 && reg.nBits() == 128);
1386  reg.offset(64);
1387  reg.nBits(64);
1388  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr val = d->readRegister(reg);
1389  d->write(args[0], val);
1390  } else {
1391  ASSERT_not_reachable("one of the args should have been an XMM register");
1392  }
1393  }

1421 // Move scalar double-precision floating-point values
1422 // This is the floating point MOVSD instruction, not the string MOVSD instruction.
1423 // I.e., this is for x86_movsd_sse, not x86_movsd.
1424 struct IP_movsd: P {
1425  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1426  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1427  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1428  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1429  } else {
1430  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = ops->unsignedExtend(d->read(args[1]), 64);
1431  if (isSgAsmDirectRegisterExpression(args[1])) {
1432  // register->memory or register->register. High order 64 bits are unchanged.
1433  if (SgAsmDirectRegisterExpression *rre = isSgAsmDirectRegisterExpression(args[0])) {
1434  RegisterDescriptor reg = rre->get_descriptor();
1435  ASSERT_require(reg.offset() == 0 && reg.nBits() == 128);
1436  reg.nBits(64);
1437  d->writeRegister(reg, src);
1438  } else {
1439  d->write(args[0], src);
1440  }
1441  } else {
1442  // memory->register. High order 64 bits are zeroed.
1443  d->write(args[0], ops->unsignedExtend(src, 128));
1444  }
1445  }
1446  }
1447 };

1457  if (isSgAsmDirectRegisterExpression(args[1])) {
1458  // register->memory or register->register. High order 96 bits are unchanged.
1459  if (SgAsmDirectRegisterExpression *rre = isSgAsmDirectRegisterExpression(args[0])) {
1460  RegisterDescriptor reg = rre->get_descriptor();
1461  ASSERT_require(reg.offset() == 0 && reg.nBits() == 128);
1462  reg.nBits(32);
1463  d->writeRegister(reg, src);
1464  } else {
1465  d->write(args[0], src);
1466  }
1467  } else {
1468  // memory->register. High order 96 bits are zeroed.
1469  d->write(args[0], ops->unsignedExtend(src, 128));
1470  }
1471  }
1472  }
1473 };

1475 // Move source to destination with truncation or zero extend
1476 // Used for MOVD and MOVQ
1477 struct IP_move_zero_extend: P {
1478  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1479  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1480  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1481  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1482  } else {
1483  size_t dstWidth = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
1484  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr value = d->read(args[1]);
1485  if (value->nBits() != dstWidth)
1486  value = ops->unsignedExtend(value, dstWidth);

1492 // Move source to destination with sign extend
1493 // Used for MOVD and MOVQ
1494 struct IP_move_sign_extend: P {
1495  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1496  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1497  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1498  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1499  } else {
1500  size_t dstWidth = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
1501  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr value = d->read(args[1]);
1502  if (value->nBits() < dstWidth)
1503  value = ops->signExtend(value, dstWidth);

1509 // Move from one location to another without any extension or truncation.

1515  } else {

1517  }

1521 // Move data from string to string
1522 // The disassembler produces MOVSB, MOVSW, MOVSD, or MOVSQ without any arguments (never MOVS with an arg)
1523 // The floating-point version of MOVSD is called x86_movsd_sse
1524 struct IP_movestring: P {
1525  const X86RepeatPrefix repeat;
1526  const size_t nbits;
1527  const size_t nbytes;
1528  IP_movestring(X86RepeatPrefix repeat, size_t nbits): repeat(repeat), nbits(nbits), nbytes(nbits/8) {
1529  ASSERT_require(8==nbits || 16==nbits || 32==nbits || 64==nbits);
1530  ASSERT_require(x86_repeat_none==repeat || x86_repeat_repe==repeat);
1531  }
1532  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1533  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
1534  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1535  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1536  } else {
1537  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr inLoop = d->repEnter(repeat);
1538 
1539  // Get the source and destination addresses
1540  RegisterDescriptor srcReg, dstReg;
1541  switch (insn->get_addressSize()) {
1542  case x86_insnsize_16:
1543  srcReg = d->REG_SI;
1544  dstReg = d->REG_DI;
1545  break;
1546  case x86_insnsize_32:
1547  srcReg = d->REG_ESI;
1548  dstReg = d->REG_EDI;
1549  break;
1550  case x86_insnsize_64:
1551  srcReg = d->REG_RSI;
1552  dstReg = d->REG_RDI;
1553  break;
1554  default:
1555  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid instruction address size");
1556  }
1557  ASSERT_forbid(srcReg.isEmpty());
1558  ASSERT_forbid(dstReg.isEmpty());
1559  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr srcRegVal = d->readRegister(srcReg);
1560  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dstRegVal = d->readRegister(dstReg);
1561 
1562  // Adjust address width depending on how memory is accessed. All addresses in memory have the same width.
1563  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr srcAddr = d->fixMemoryAddress(srcRegVal);
1564  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dstAddr = d->fixMemoryAddress(dstRegVal);
1565  ASSERT_require(srcAddr->nBits() == dstAddr->nBits());
1566 
1567  // Copy a value from source to destination
1568  RegisterDescriptor sr(x86_regclass_segment,
1569  insn->get_segmentOverride()!=x86_segreg_none ? insn->get_segmentOverride() : x86_segreg_ds,
1570  0, 16);
1571  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr value = ops->readMemory(sr, srcAddr, ops->undefined_(nbits), inLoop);
1572  ops->writeMemory(d->REG_ES, dstAddr, value, inLoop);
1573 
1574  // Adjust the address registers
1575  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr positiveNBytes = ops->number_(srcReg.nBits(), +nbytes);
1576  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr negativeNBytes = ops->number_(srcReg.nBits(), -nbytes);
1577  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr step = ops->ite(d->readRegister(d->REG_DF), negativeNBytes, positiveNBytes);
1578  d->writeRegister(srcReg, ops->ite(inLoop, ops->add(srcRegVal, step), srcRegVal));
1579  d->writeRegister(dstReg, ops->ite(inLoop, ops->add(dstRegVal, step), dstRegVal));
1580 
1581  // Adjust instruction pointer register to either repeat the instruction or fall through
1582  if (x86_repeat_none!=repeat)
1583  d->repLeave(repeat, inLoop, insn->get_address(), false/*no ZF*/);
1584  }
1585  }
1586 };
1587 
1588 // Unsigned multiply
1589 struct IP_mul: P {
1590  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1591  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
1592  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1593  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1594  } else {
1595  // Read the two factors to be multiplied
1596  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr factor1 = d->read(args[0]);
1597  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr factor2;
1598  switch (factor1->nBits()) {
1599  case 8:
1600  factor2 = d->readRegister(d->REG_AL);
1601  break;
1602  case 16:
1603  factor2 = d->readRegister(d->REG_AX);
1604  break;
1605  case 32:
1606  factor2 = d->readRegister(d->REG_EAX);
1607  break;
1608  case 64:
1609  factor2 = d->readRegister(d->REG_RAX);
1610  break;
1611  default:
1612  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid operand size");
1613  }
1614 
1615  // Compute the result
1616  ASSERT_not_null(factor2);
1617  ASSERT_require(factor1->nBits() == factor2->nBits());
1618  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr product = ops->unsignedMultiply(factor1, factor2);
1619 
1620  // Save the result
1621  switch (factor1->nBits()) {
1622  case 8:
1623  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX, product);
1624  break;
1625  case 16:
1626  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX, ops->extract(product, 0, 16));
1627  d->writeRegister(d->REG_DX, ops->extract(product, 16, 32));
1628  break;
1629  case 32:
1630  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EAX, ops->extract(product, 0, 32));
1631  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EDX, ops->extract(product, 32, 64));
1632  break;
1633  case 64:
1634  d->writeRegister(d->REG_RAX, ops->extract(product, 0, 64));
1635  d->writeRegister(d->REG_RDX, ops->extract(product, 64, 128));
1636  break;
1637  default:
1638  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid operand size");
1639  }
1640 
1641  // Set flags
1642  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr carry = ops->invert(ops->equalToZero(ops->extract(product, factor1->nBits(),
1643  2 * factor1->nBits())));
1644  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CF, carry);
1645  d->writeRegister(d->REG_OF, carry);
1646  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1647  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ZF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1648  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1649  d->writeRegister(d->REG_PF, ops->unspecified_(1));
1650  }
1651  }
1652 };

1659  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1660  } else {
1661  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr srcVal = d->read(args[0]);
1662  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr no = ops->boolean_(false);
1663  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr invertedSrcVal = ops->invert(srcVal);
1664  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = d->doAddOperation(ops->number_(srcVal->nBits(), 0),
1665  invertedSrcVal, true, no);

1667  }

1700  if (a->nBits() > b->nBits())

1709  }

1713 // Packed absolute value
1714 // PABSB
1715 // PABSW
1716 // PABSD
1717 struct IP_pabs: P {
1718  size_t bitsPerOp;
1719  IP_pabs(size_t bitsPerOp): bitsPerOp(bitsPerOp) {}
1720  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1721  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1722  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1723  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1724  } else {
1725  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
1726  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
1727  size_t nOps = src->nBits() / bitsPerOp;
1728  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
1729  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr part = ops->extract(src, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
1730  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr signBit = ops->extract(src, (i+1)*bitsPerOp-1, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
1731  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr absVal = ops->ite(signBit, ops->negate(part), part);
1732  result = result ? ops->concat(result, absVal) : absVal;
1733  }
1734  d->write(args[0], result);
1735  }
1736  }
1737 };

1892  } else {
1893  size_t nbits = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
1894  if (64!=nbits && 128!=nbits) {
1895  throw BaseSemantics::Exception("first operand must be 64 or 128 bits wide (actual " +
1896  StringUtility::plural(nbits, "bits") + ")", insn);
1897  }

1899  throw BaseSemantics::Exception("first and second operands must be the same type", insn);
1900  SgAsmIntegerValueExpression *nBytes = isSgAsmIntegerValueExpression(args[2]);
1901  if (!nBytes)
1902  throw BaseSemantics::Exception("third operand must be a byte value expression (imm8)", insn);
1903  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr arg1 = d->read(args[1]);
1904  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr wide = ops->concat(d->read(args[0]), arg1);
1905  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = ops->extract(ops->shiftRight(wide, d->number_(8, nBytes->get_value() * 8)),
1906  0, nbits);
1907  d->write(args[0], result);
1908  }

1943 // Packed average
1944 // PAVGB
1945 // PAVGW
1946 struct IP_pavg: P {
1947  size_t bitsPerOp;
1948  IP_pavg(size_t bitsPerOp): bitsPerOp(bitsPerOp) {}
1949  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1950  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1951  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1952  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1953  } else {
1954  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
1955  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
1956  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
1957  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / bitsPerOp;

1959  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
1960  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
1961  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);

1963  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr one = ops->number_(bitsPerOp+1, 1);
1964  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr sum = ops->add(ops->add(ops->unsignedExtend(partA, bitsPerOp+1), partBWide),
1965  one);
1966  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ave = ops->extract(sum, 1, bitsPerOp+1);
1967  result = result ? ops->concat(result, ave) : ave;
1968  }

1973 // Variable blend packed bytes
1974 struct IP_pblendvb: P {
1975  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
1976  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
1977  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
1978  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
1979  } else {
1980  static const size_t bitsPerOp = 8;
1981  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
1982  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
1983  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr xmm0 = d->readRegister(RegisterDescriptor(x86_regclass_xmm, 0, 0, 128));
1984  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
1985  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / bitsPerOp;
1986  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
1987  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
1988  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
1989  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
1990  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr selector = ops->extract(xmm0, i*8+7, i*8+8);
1991  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr selected = ops->ite(selector, b, a);
1992  result = result ? ops->concat(result, selected) : selected;
1993  }
1994  }
1995  }

1998 // Blend packed words

2001  assert_args(insn, args, 3);
2002  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2003  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2004  } else {
2005  static const size_t bitsPerOp = 16;
2006  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
2007  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
2008  uint64_t mask = d->read(args[2])->toUnsigned().get(); // must be an immediate operand
2009  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
2010  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / bitsPerOp;
2011  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2012  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
2013  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
2014  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
2015  bool selector = (mask >> i) & 1;
2016  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr selected = selector ? b : a;
2017  result = result ? ops->concat(result, selected) : selected;
2018  }
2019  }
2020  }
2021 };

2023 // Compare packed data for equal
2024 struct IP_pcmpeq: P {
2025  size_t nCmpBits; // number of bits to compare at once
2026  IP_pcmpeq(size_t nCmpBits): nCmpBits(nCmpBits) {}
2027  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2028  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2029  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2030  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2031  } else {
2032  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
2033  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
2034  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
2035  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() % nCmpBits == 0);
2036  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2037  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero = ops->number_(nCmpBits, 0);
2038  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ones = ops->invert(zero);
2039  for (size_t i=0; i<a->nBits()/nCmpBits; ++i) {
2040  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*nCmpBits, (i+1)*nCmpBits);
2041  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*nCmpBits, (i+1)*nCmpBits);
2042  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr diff = ops->add(partA, ops->negate(partB));
2043  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr c = ops->ite(ops->equalToZero(diff), ones, zero);
2044  if (0==i) {
2045  result = c;
2046  } else {

2049  }

2055 // Compare packed signed integer for greater-than
2056 // PCMPGTB
2057 // PCMPGTW
2058 // PCMPGTD
2059 // PCMPGTQ
2060 struct IP_pcmpgt: P {
2061  size_t bitsPerOp;
2062  IP_pcmpgt(size_t bitsPerOp): bitsPerOp(bitsPerOp) {}
2063  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2064  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2065  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2066  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2067  } else {
2068  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
2069  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
2070  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
2071  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / bitsPerOp;
2072  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero = ops->number_(bitsPerOp, 0);
2073  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr ones = ops->invert(zero);
2074  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2075  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
2076  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
2077  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
2078  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partBWide = ops->signExtend(partB, bitsPerOp+1);
2079  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr diff = ops->subtract(ops->signExtend(partA, bitsPerOp+1), partBWide);
2080  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isLT = ops->extract(diff, bitsPerOp, bitsPerOp+1);
2081  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isEQ = ops->equalToZero(diff);
2082  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isLE = ops->or_(isLT, isEQ);
2083  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr answer = ops->ite(isLE, zero, ones);
2084  result = result ? ops->concat(result, answer) : answer;
2085  }
2086  d->write(args[0], result);
2087  }
2088  }
2089 };

2091 // Extract byte, dword, qword

2093 // PEXTRD
2094 // PEXTRW
2095 // PEXTRQ

2097  size_t bitsPerOp;

2100  assert_args(insn, args, 3);

2102  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2103  } else {
2104  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
2105  uint64_t index = d->read(args[2])->toUnsigned().get(); // must be an immediate operand
2106  switch (bitsPerOp) {
2107  case 8:
2108  index &= 0x0f;
2109  break;
2110  case 16:
2111  if (64==src->nBits()) {

2117  case 32:

2120  case 64:
2121  index &= 0x01;
2122  break;
2123  default:
2124  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid operand size");
2125  }
2126  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr extracted = ops->extract(src, index*bitsPerOp, (index+1)*bitsPerOp);
2127  size_t dstWidth = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());

2129  d->write(args[0], result);

2521  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2522  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2523  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2524  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2525  } else {
2526  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
2527  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2528  for (size_t byteIdx=0; byteIdx<src->nBits()/8; ++byteIdx) {
2529  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr bit = ops->extract(src, 8*byteIdx+7, 8*byteIdx+8);
2530  result = result ? ops->concat(result, bit) : bit;
2531  }
2532  result = ops->unsignedExtend(result, asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type()));
2533  d->write(args[0], result);
2534  }
2535  }
2536 };

2596 // Multiply packed signed dword integers
2597 // PMULDQ
2598 struct IP_pmuldq: P {
2599  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2600  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2601  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2602  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2603  } else {
2604  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dst = d->read(args[0]);
2605  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
2606  ASSERT_require(dst->nBits() == src->nBits());
2607  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dst_0_32 = ops->extract(dst, 0, 32);
2608  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr prod0 = ops->signedMultiply(ops->extract(src, 0, 32), dst_0_32);
2609  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dst_64_96 = ops->extract(dst, 64, 96);
2610  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr prod1 = ops->signedMultiply(ops->extract(src, 64, 96), dst_64_96);
2611  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result = ops->concat(prod0, prod1);
2612  d->write(args[0], result);
2613  }
2614  }
2615 };

2617 // Packed multiply high with round and scale
2618 // PMULHRSW
2619 struct IP_pmulhrsw: P {
2620  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2621  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2622  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2623  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2624  } else {
2625  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
2626  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
2627  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
2628  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / 16;
2629  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2630  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
2631  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*16, (i+1)*16);
2632  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*16, (i+1)*16);
2633  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr product = ops->unsignedMultiply(partA, partB);
2634  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr one32 = ops->number_(32, 1);
2635  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr scaled = ops->extract(ops->add(ops->shiftRight(product, ops->number_(32, 14)),
2636  one32),
2637  1, 17);
2638  result = result ? ops->concat(result, scaled) : scaled;
2639  }
2640  d->write(args[0], result);
2641  }
2642  }
2643 };

2652  } else {

2747 // Pop from stack
2748 struct IP_pop: P {
2749  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2750  assert_args(insn, args, 1);
2751  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2752  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2753  } else {
2754  // Stack pointer register
2755  RegisterDescriptor sp;
2756  switch (insn->get_addressSize()) {
2757  case x86_insnsize_16: sp = d->REG_SP; break;
2758  case x86_insnsize_32: sp = d->REG_ESP; break;
2759  case x86_insnsize_64: sp = d->REG_RSP; break;
2760  default:
2761  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid address size");
2762  }
2763  ASSERT_forbid(sp.isEmpty());
2764 
2765  // Increment the stack pointer before writing to args[0] just in case args[0] is stack-relative
2766  size_t operandWidth = asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type());
2767  ASSERT_require(operandWidth % 8 == 0);
2768  size_t stackDelta = operandWidth / 8;
2769  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldSp = d->readRegister(sp);
2770  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newSp = ops->add(oldSp, ops->number_(sp.nBits(), stackDelta));
2771  d->writeRegister(sp, newSp);
2772 
2773  // Read from stack and write to args[0]
2774  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
2775  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefA = ops->undefined_(operandWidth);
2776  d->write(args[0], ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, d->fixMemoryAddress(oldSp), undefA, yes));
2777  }
2778  }
2779 };
2780 
2781 // Pop flags register from stack
2782 // POPF
2783 // POPFD
2784 // POPFQ
2785 struct IP_pop_flags: P {
2786  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2787  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
2788  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2789  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2790  } else {
2791  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr stackVa = d->readRegister(d->REG_anySP);
2792  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldFlags, poppedFlags;
2793  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
2794  RegisterDescriptor flagsReg;
2795  switch (insn->get_operandSize()) {
2796  case x86_insnsize_16: {
2797  oldFlags = d->readRegister(flagsReg = d->REG_FLAGS);
2798  poppedFlags = ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, stackVa, ops->undefined_(16), yes);
2799  break;
2800  }
2801  case x86_insnsize_32: {
2802  oldFlags = d->readRegister(flagsReg = d->REG_EFLAGS);
2803  poppedFlags = ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, stackVa, ops->undefined_(32), yes);
2804  break;
2805  }
2806  case x86_insnsize_64: {
2807  oldFlags = d->readRegister(flagsReg = d->REG_RFLAGS);
2808  poppedFlags = ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, stackVa, ops->undefined_(64), yes);
2809  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero32 = ops->number_(32, 0);
2810  poppedFlags = ops->concat(ops->unsignedExtend(poppedFlags, 32), zero32);
2811  break;
2812  }
2813  default:
2814  ASSERT_not_reachable("invalid operand size");
2815  }
2816  stackVa = ops->add(stackVa, ops->number_(stackVa->nBits(), poppedFlags->nBits()/8));
2817  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, stackVa);
2818 
2819  // Clear VIP (bit 19) and VIF (bit 20); i.e., clear bits 0x00180000
2820  // Keep IOPL (bits 12 and 13) and VM (bit 17), i.e., preserve bits 0x00023000
2821  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newFlags = ops->extract(poppedFlags, 0, 12);
2822  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(oldFlags, 12, 14)); // IOPL (bits 12 & 13) is preserved
2823  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(poppedFlags, 14, 16));
2824  if (oldFlags->nBits() >= 32) {
2825  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(poppedFlags, 16, 17));
2826  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(oldFlags, 17, 18)); // VM (bit 17) is preserved
2827  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(poppedFlags, 18, 19));
2828  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->number_(2, 0)); // VIP (19) and VIF (20) are cleared
2829  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->extract(poppedFlags, 21, 32));
2830  if (oldFlags->nBits() == 64)
2831  newFlags = ops->concat(newFlags, ops->number_(32, 0));
2832  }
2833  d->writeRegister(flagsReg, newFlags);
2834  }
2835  }
2836 };
2837 
2838 // Pop all general-purpose registers
2839 // POPA - 16-bit registers
2840 // POPAD - 32-bit registers
2841 // Invalid for 64-bit
2842 struct IP_pop_gprs: P {
2843  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2844  assert_args(insn, args, 0);
2845  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2846  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2847  } else if (insn->get_addressSize() == x86_insnsize_16) {
2848  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldSp = d->readRegister(d->REG_anySP);
2849  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newSp = ops->add(oldSp, ops->number_(oldSp->nBits(), 16));
2850  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr base = d->fixMemoryAddress(oldSp);
2851  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
2852  d->writeRegister(d->REG_DI,
2853  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, base,
2854  ops->undefined_(16), yes));
2855  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefSI = ops->undefined_(16);
2856  d->writeRegister(d->REG_SI,
2857  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 2)), undefSI, yes));
2858  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefBP = ops->undefined_(16);
2859  d->writeRegister(d->REG_BP,
2860  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 4)), undefBP, yes));
2861  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefX = ops->undefined_(16);
2862  (void) ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 6)), undefX, yes);
2863  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefBX = ops->undefined_(16);
2864  d->writeRegister(d->REG_BX,
2865  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 8)), undefBX, yes));
2866  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefDX = ops->undefined_(16);
2867  d->writeRegister(d->REG_DX,
2868  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 10)), undefDX, yes));
2869  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefCX = ops->undefined_(16);
2870  d->writeRegister(d->REG_CX,
2871  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 12)), undefCX, yes));
2872  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefAX = ops->undefined_(16);
2873  d->writeRegister(d->REG_AX,
2874  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 14)), undefAX, yes));
2875  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, newSp);
2876  } else if (insn->get_addressSize() == x86_insnsize_32) {
2877  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr oldSp = d->readRegister(d->REG_anySP);
2878  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr newSp = ops->add(oldSp, ops->number_(oldSp->nBits(), 32));
2879  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr base = d->fixMemoryAddress(oldSp);
2880  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr yes = ops->boolean_(true);
2881  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EDI,
2882  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, base,
2883  ops->undefined_(32), yes));
2884  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefESI = ops->undefined_(32);
2885  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ESI,
2886  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 4)), undefESI, yes));
2887  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefEBP = ops->undefined_(32);
2888  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EBP,
2889  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 8)), undefEBP, yes));
2890  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefX = ops->undefined_(32);
2891  (void) ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 12)), undefX, yes);
2892  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefEBX = ops->undefined_(32);
2893  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EBX,
2894  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 16)), undefEBX, yes));
2895  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefEDX = ops->undefined_(32);
2896  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EDX,
2897  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 20)), undefEDX, yes));
2898  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefECX = ops->undefined_(32);
2899  d->writeRegister(d->REG_ECX,
2900  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 24)), undefECX, yes));
2901  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr undefEAX = ops->undefined_(32);
2902  d->writeRegister(d->REG_EAX,
2903  ops->readMemory(d->REG_SS, ops->add(base, ops->number_(base->nBits(), 28)), undefEAX, yes));
2904  d->writeRegister(d->REG_anySP, newSp);
2905  } else {
2906  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0); // 64-bit mode
2907  }
2908  }
2909 };

2911 // Count number of bits set
2912 struct IP_popcnt: P {
2913  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2914  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2915  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2916  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2917  } else {
2918  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
2919  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr total = ops->number_(asm_type_width(args[0]->get_type()), 0);
2920  for (size_t i=0; i<src->nBits(); ++i) {
2921  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr srcBit = ops->extract(src, i, i+1);
2922  total = ops->add(total, ops->unsignedExtend(srcBit, total->nBits()));
2923  }
2924  d->write(args[0], total);
2925  }
2926  }
2927 };

2946 // Compute sum of absolute differences
2947 // PSADBW
2948 struct IP_psadbw: P {
2949  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2950  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2951  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2952  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2953  } else {
2954  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dst = d->read(args[0]);
2955  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
2956  ASSERT_require(dst->nBits() == src->nBits());
2957  ASSERT_require(dst->nBits() == 64 || dst->nBits() == 128);
2958  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2959  size_t nSums = dst->nBits() / 64;
2960  for (size_t i=0; i<nSums; ++i) {
2961  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr sum;
2962  for (size_t j=0; j<8; ++j) {
2963  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(dst, i*64+j*8, i*64+j*8+8);
2964  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(src, i*64+j*8, i*64+j*8+8);
2965  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr diffAB = ops->subtract(partA, partB);
2966  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr diffBA = ops->subtract(partB, partA);
2967  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr absDiff = ops->ite(ops->isUnsignedLessThan(partA, partB), diffBA, diffAB);
2968  sum = sum ? ops->add(sum, absDiff) : absDiff;
2969  }
2970  sum = ops->unsignedExtend(sum, 64);
2971  result = result ? ops->concat(result, sum) : sum;
2972  }
2973  d->write(args[0], result);
2974  }
2975  }
2976 };

2978 // Shuffle packed bytes (or set to zero)
2979 // PSHUFB
2980 struct IP_pshufb: P {
2981  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
2982  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
2983  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
2984  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
2985  } else {
2986  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr original = d->read(args[0]);
2987  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr indices = d->read(args[1]);
2988  ASSERT_require(original->nBits() == indices->nBits());
2989  size_t nOps = original->nBits() / 8;
2990  size_t bitsPerIndex = 64 == original->nBits() ? 3 : 4;
2991  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr eight = ops->number_(4, 8);
2992  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
2993  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
2994  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr indexMsb = ops->extract(indices, i*8+7, i*8+8);
2995  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr index = ops->extract(indices, i*8, i*8+bitsPerIndex);
2996  // The extract operator only works with concrete bit indices, so we use right shift and masking instead.
2997  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr selected = ops->shiftRight(original, ops->unsignedMultiply(index, eight));
2998  selected = ops->unsignedExtend(selected, 8);
2999  selected = ops->ite(indexMsb, ops->number_(8, 0), selected);
3000  result = result ? ops->concat(result, selected) : selected;
3001  }
3002  d->write(args[0], result);
3003  }
3004  }
3005 };
3006 
3007 // Shuffle packed doublewords
3008 // PSHUFD
3009 struct IP_pshufd: P {
3010  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
3011  assert_args(insn, args, 3);
3012  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
3013  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
3014  } else {
3015  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr src = d->read(args[1]);
3016  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr order = d->read(args[2]);
3017  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
3018  ASSERT_require(order->toUnsigned());
3019  for (size_t i=0; i<4; ++i) {
3020  size_t dwordIdx = ((order->toUnsigned().get() >> (i*2)) & 0x3);
3021  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr dword = ops->extract(src, 32*dwordIdx, 32*(dwordIdx+1));
3022  result = result ? ops->concat(result, dword) : dword;
3023  }
3024  d->write(args[0], result);
3025  }
3026  }
3027 };

3099 // Packed sign
3100 // PSIGNB
3101 // PSIGNW
3102 // PSIGND
3103 struct IP_psign: P {
3104  size_t bitsPerOp;
3105  IP_psign(size_t bitsPerOp): bitsPerOp(bitsPerOp) {}
3106  void p(D d, Ops ops, I insn, A args) {
3107  assert_args(insn, args, 2);
3108  if (insn->get_lockPrefix()) {
3109  ops->interrupt(x86_exception_ud, 0);
3110  } else {
3111  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr a = d->read(args[0]);
3112  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr b = d->read(args[1]);
3113  ASSERT_require(a->nBits() == b->nBits());
3114  size_t nOps = a->nBits() / bitsPerOp;
3115  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr result;
3116  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr zero = ops->number_(bitsPerOp, 0);
3117  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr allSet = ops->invert(zero);
3118  for (size_t i=0; i<nOps; ++i) {
3119  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partA = ops->extract(a, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
3120  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partB = ops->extract(b, i*bitsPerOp, (i+1)*bitsPerOp);
3121  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isZero = ops->equalToZero(b);
3122  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr isNegative = ops->extract(b, bitsPerOp-1, bitsPerOp);
3123  BaseSemantics::SValue::Ptr partC = ops->ite(isNegative, allSet, ops->ite(isZero, zero, partA));
3124  result = result ? ops->concat(result, partC) : partC;
3125  }
3126  d->write(args[0], result);
3127  }
3128  }
3129 };
